panel.title: Care home panel
panel.overLimit: The care home has more than {{limit}} active residents. Contact ETNARA to review your plan. Nothing is blocked.
panel.modulesNote: ETNARA turns modules on when they are ready for your care home.

full.occupancyNoCapacity: Rooms: {{rooms}} · active residents: {{residents}} · bed capacity not configured
full.overCapacity: Some rooms are above their registered beds
full.capacityNote: Registered beds are the home's internal data; they are not the capacity authorized by the Department of the Family.

staffHours.title: Staff hours
staffHours.description: Record and approve hours worked, keep each person's pay rate and prepare an estimated pay calculation per period.
staffHours.estimateNotice: Amounts are estimates. They are not payroll or payment processing: ETNARA does not calculate taxes, deductions or contributions and does not move money.
staffHours.adminOnlyTitle: This section is for administrators only.
staffHours.adminOnlyDetail: Staff hours and pay rates are handled by a care home administrator.
staffHours.loadFailed: Hours or rates could not be loaded.
staffHours.periodUnavailableDetail: ETNARA could not confirm the summary with the server. Hours stay visible, but closing and exporting are blocked until it is recovered.
staffHours.missingRateDetail: Without a pay rate, the estimated pay for those hours is $0.
staffHours.periodDetail: Groups the approved hours and the estimated pay for the period.
staffHours.historyUnavailable: We could not load the history of closed periods. The figures above are confirmed.
staffHours.resolveFirst: Resolve pending or disputed timesheets before closing the period.
staffHours.confirmClose: Close the period from {{from}} to {{to}}? It will be recorded as closed.
staffHours.errorOverlap: That period overlaps one already closed: a timesheet is already in another period.
staffHours.errorClose: The period could not be closed on the server. Check that there are no exceptions.
staffHours.ratesDetail: Each person's hourly pay rate; it is used for the estimated pay when hours are approved. Only the care home administration sees it.
staffHours.invalidRate: Enter a valid amount (0 to 1,000 USD).
staffHours.errorRate: The rate could not be saved.

establishments.title: Facilities and rooms
establishments.description: Units, rooms, beds and resident placement for each facility.
establishments.emptyDetail: Create them in Settings → Facilities. The “General” unit is created automatically.

occupancy.overCapacity: At least one room has more residents than registered beds. This is only a notice: nothing is blocked.
occupancy.disclaimer: Beds registered by the care home. This is not the capacity authorized by the Department of the Family.

units.title: Units and rooms
units.hint: Rooms can go directly in “General”. Additional units (floors, wings or sections) are optional.

residents.title: Resident placement
residents.empty: There are no active residents in this facility.

geofence.title: Geofence
geofence.explain: It will only be used when clocking in to mark “inside” or “outside”: it never blocks a clock-in, does not track and does not store people's location.
geofence.centerError: Enter a valid latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
geofence.reasonHint: Every change is recorded with its author and reason.

closure.title: Close facility
closure.explain: Archives the facility with its units and rooms. Nothing is deleted. It requires no active residents, current or future shifts or active assignments.
closure.cannot: It cannot be closed yet: resolve the items above first.
closure.willArchive: The facility, its units and rooms and the staff links to it will be archived. Nothing is deleted and it cannot be undone from the portal.

dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.generalHint: “General” can be renamed, but not archived while it has active rooms.
dialogs.unitHint: For example: Upper floor, North wing.
dialogs.unitActiveRooms: It has {{count}} active room(s): archive or move them first.
dialogs.bedsError: A whole number greater than 0, or empty.
dialogs.roomHasResidents: It has residents: move them before archiving it.
dialogs.fullWarning: All registered beds in this room are already occupied. You can still save: this is only a notice.

toasts.placedOver: Placement saved. Notice: the room exceeds its registered beds.

settings.closureRequired: Care home facilities are not archived here. Use Care home → Facilities and rooms → “Close facility”, which checks residents, shifts and assignments before closing it.

errors.fallback: The change could not be saved.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_NAME_TAKEN: There is already an active unit or room with that name in this facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_UNIT_HAS_ACTIVE_ROOMS: Archive or move this unit's active rooms first.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_HAS_RESIDENTS: The room has active residents. Move them before archiving it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_LOCATION_IMMUTABLE: A room cannot move to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_LOCATION_MISMATCH: The room belongs to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_REQUIRED: Care home facilities are closed with “Close facility” (Care home → Facilities and rooms).
errors.RESIDENTIAL_TRANSFER_ACTIVE_SHIFTS: The resident has current or future shifts in their current facility. Cancel or reassign them before transferring the resident to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_FUTURE_SHIFTS: There are current or future shifts in this facility. Cancel them before closing it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS: There are active assignments in this facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_ACTIVE_RESIDENTS: There are active residents in this facility. Transfer or discharge them before closing it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_REASON_REQUIRED: Write the reason for the change.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the care home administration can make this change.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the data: a value is not valid.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Plan the facility's shifts for the week. Staff only see the shifts once you publish.
schedule.noEstablishmentsDetail: Create a facility in Settings to plan its week.
schedule.draftExplain: While it is a draft, none of this is a shift and no staff member can see it. Publishing creates the shifts and requests the assignments with the usual rules (compliance and no overlaps).
schedule.removedTitle: Published shifts that will be removed
schedule.removedExplain: These published shifts will be cancelled when you publish again.

warnings.duplicate: {{name}} appears twice in the same shift.
warnings.publishBlocked: Fix the warnings before publishing: a week with overlapping or duplicated shifts is not published.

summary.title: Scheduled hours
summary.note: These are planned hours, not hours worked. An overnight shift splits its hours between both days.

dialogs.editPublished: This shift is already published. Saving replaces it, and staff get the change when you publish again.
dialogs.hoursHint: Between 0.25 and 24 hours. It may end the next day.
dialogs.hoursError: The duration must be between 0.25 and 24 hours.
dialogs.personHint: You can leave it unassigned. Publishing checks compliance and that the person has no other shift at the same time.
dialogs.label: Label (optional)
dialogs.removeDraft: It will be removed from the draft.
dialogs.removePublished: This shift is already published. It will be cancelled when you publish again; until then staff still see it.
dialogs.copyBody: The shifts of the week of {{from}} will be copied to this week as a draft. It only works if this week is empty.
dialogs.applyExplain: The template's shifts are added to this week as a draft, with nobody assigned.
dialogs.noTemplates: There are no templates for this facility yet.
dialogs.saveTemplateExplain: This week's days, times, durations, roles and labels are saved. Assigned people are not saved.
dialogs.publishBody: This week's shifts will be created and each assigned person will be asked to accept theirs. Removed shifts will be cancelled. Every publication is kept in the history.

toasts.published: Week published. Staff can now see their shifts.

errors.fallback: It could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_IN_PAST: Some shifts have already started or are in the past. Remove or change them before publishing.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH: There are no changes to publish.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_OVERLAP: The same person has overlapping or duplicated shifts. Fix them before publishing.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_PUBLISHED_ENTRY: That shift is already published and cannot be changed that way.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_SHIFT_STARTED: That shift has already started: it cannot be changed or cancelled from the schedule.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_STAFF_NOT_ACTIVE: That person is no longer active in the home.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_STAFF_NOT_ELIGIBLE: An assigned person does not meet the compliance requirements. Check Compliance or leave the shift unassigned.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_STAFF_CONFLICT: An assigned person already has another shift at that time.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_WEEK_NOT_EMPTY: This week already has shifts. Copying only works on an empty week.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_WEEK_START_INVALID: The week must start on a Monday.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_WEEK: The shift must start within this week.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SCHEDULE_IMMUTABLE: That record can no longer be changed.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the home's management can plan the week.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED: The weekly schedule is not enabled for this home.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the data: a value is not valid.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Weekly QR code, punch review, corrections and alerts. No irregularity removes hours or creates deductions.
attendance.reasonHint: Required. It is kept in the history.

codes.explain: The QR applies every Monday at 00:00 and can be printed from 72 hours before. Neither the QR nor the 6-digit code is stored: they are generated when printing. Without a signed-in session they cannot be used to punch.
codes.versionLine: Version {{version}} · {{hours}} h transition only to close sessions
codes.revokeBody: The current code stops working immediately (also during the transition) and a new one is generated that must be printed.
codes.transitionActive: Last week's code still closes sessions opened with it until {{until}}. It never opens a clock-in.

printSheet.title: Attendance · {{name}}
printSheet.instructions: Scan the QR with the phone camera or type the code in «Punch». You need to be signed in: the QR alone authorizes nothing.
printSheet.version: Version {{version}}. If it is revoked, this sheet stops working.

flags.clock_skew: Phone clock off by more than 15 min
flags.impossible_order: Impossible order compared with other punches
flags.transition_not_for_entry: The previous code cannot be used to clock in
flags.no_geofence_center: The facility has no geofence centre

review.explain: Validate, justify or mark as not recognized, always with a reason. The original punch does not change and nothing removes hours.
review.reasonBody: The decision is added to the history with your name. «Not recognized» keeps the punch and creates no deductions.
review.offlineTimes: Time declared by the phone: {{declared}} · received: {{received}}

corrections.approveBody: A justified manual punch is recorded with the requested time. If it fixed a punch, the original becomes «not recognized» and is kept.
corrections.rejectBody: The person will see your reason.

alerts.explain: Alerts flag something to review; they are not proof of fraud.
alerts.emptyDetail: Here you will see punches outside the perimeter, repeat cases, long sessions and blocked attempts.

kind.recidivism: 3 or more punches outside the perimeter in 7 days
kind.long_session: Session open 16 hours or more (it does not close by itself)

week.notice: Administrative attendance data. It is not payroll: ETNARA does not calculate pay or deductions. Validated and pending hours are shown separately.
week.csvNotice: Administrative attendance record. It is not payroll. Keeping employment records is the home's obligation.
week.emptyDetail: Published shifts with assigned people will appear here.

policy.explain: Versioned policy (current version: {{version}}). Tolerances are administrative data and never deduct hours.
policy.transitionHint: Time during which the previous code still closes sessions opened with it.

toasts.revoked: Code revoked. Print the new one.

consent.title: Location when punching
consent.body: If you accept, your location is read only once when you punch to know whether you are at the facility. There is no tracking and no coordinates are stored: only «inside», «outside» and the approximate distance. You can withdraw it at any time; without it you can still punch.

punch.title: Punch
punch.description: Record your clock-in, clock-out, breaks and meals with the facility QR or its 6-digit code.
punch.noShiftsTitle: You have no shifts to punch now
punch.noShiftsDetail: Your accepted shifts for the next 24 hours appear here.
punch.sessionOpen: You have an open session on this shift.
punch.pinHint: It is printed next to the facility QR.
punch.okPending: Punch recorded. It is pending review by the management.
punch.pendingExplain: No hours are lost: the management will review it.
punch.queued: Offline: the punch was saved on the phone (without location) and will be sent when the signal returns. It will be pending review.
punch.queueDetail: They will be sent automatically when the connection returns, with the time you punched.

correction.title: Request a correction
correction.which: What do you want to correct?

errors.fallback: It could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.ATTENDANCE_UNAVAILABLE: Attendance is not available right now. Use the contingency sheet and tell the management.
errors.ATTENDANCE_NOT_AUTHORIZED: That shift is not yours or is not accepted: you cannot punch on it.
errors.ATTENDANCE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes or ask the management for help.
errors.ATTENDANCE_CODE_NOT_AVAILABLE: That code is not available yet or is not for this week.
errors.ATTENDANCE_CODE_KEY_RETIRED: That code was issued with a retired key. Revoke it to generate a new one.
errors.ATTENDANCE_DOWNLOAD_LIMIT: Today's download limit for the code has been reached.
errors.ATTENDANCE_SELF_REVIEW: Nobody reviews, decides or records punches for themselves.
errors.ATTENDANCE_ALREADY_DECIDED: That correction has already been decided.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the home's management can do this.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED: Attendance is not enabled for this home.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the data: a value is not valid.

assignments.title: Resident assignments
assignments.description: Who cares for each resident on each shift. Staff access comes only from these assignments and changes at the stated time.
assignments.noEstablishmentsDetail: Create an establishment for the home first.
assignments.noShiftsDetail: Shifts are created in the weekly schedule.
assignments.noStaff: Nobody is assigned to this shift.
assignments.noResidents: There are no active residents in this establishment.
assignments.noHealthHint: Do not write diagnoses or health information.

assign.title: Assign residents to {{name}}
assign.body: From the stated time, this person can see and record care for the chosen residents during their shift.
assign.none: They already care for every resident.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.body: One person's access ends exactly when the other's begins.

uncovered.confirm: I confirm they will be uncovered and an alert will be created.

substitution.title: Substitute {{name}}
substitution.body: The substitution is administrative and is recorded. Blocks cannot be overridden.
substitution.noOverride: These blocks cannot be overridden. Choose another person or another time.
substitution.full: Full substitution: the shift has not started and the original person will no longer be assigned.
substitution.partial: Partial substitution: the original person keeps the time worked and their punches; the substitute covers from the stated time.
substitution.availability: This person declared they are unavailable at that time. I confirm the substitution anyway.
substitution.transfers: Who cares for each resident from that moment?
substitution.punchesKept: Original punches are not changed and hours are not duplicated: each person counts only their part.

blocks.original_not_covering: The original person is not covering the shift at that time.
blocks.already_assigned: The chosen person is already on this shift.
blocks.substitute_inactive: The chosen person is not active.
blocks.not_eligible: Not eligible: mandatory credentials are missing or expired.
blocks.role_mismatch: They do not hold the same position as the person being substituted.
blocks.not_authorized_in_establishment: They are not authorized in this establishment.

alerts.emptyDetail: When a resident is left uncovered it will show here.

mine.title: My residents
mine.description: The residents assigned to you right now. You can only see and record care for them.
mine.emptyDetail: When the administration assigns you residents they will show here.

toasts.substituted: Substitution recorded. Both people were notified.

errors.fallback: Could not complete. Please try again.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_DUPLICATE: That person already cares for that resident.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_IMMUTABLE: A closed assignment cannot be changed.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: That time is outside what this person covers on the shift.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_RESIDENT_NOT_HERE: The resident is not active in this establishment.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_SHIFT_MISMATCH: The shift does not belong to this establishment.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ASSIGNMENT_STAFF_NOT_ASSIGNE: That person has no accepted assignment on this shift.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_UNCOVERED_CONFIRMATION_REQUI: Some residents would be left uncovered: confirm and write the reason.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SUBSTITUTION_AVAILABILITY_CO: The person declared they are unavailable: confirm to continue.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SUBSTITUTION_BLOCKED: The substitution is blocked. Check again.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SUBSTITUTION_NOT_AVAILABLE: Substitutions require the schedule and assignments to be active.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_SUBSTITUTION_SHIFT_MISMATCH: The shift does not belong to this establishment.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the administration can do this.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED: This feature is not active for your organization.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the information and try again.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Administrative reports for the home: attendance and hours worked, assignments and occupancy.
reports.noEstablishmentsDetail: Create an establishment for the home first.
reports.rangeHint: Choose a range of 1 to {{max}} days, with “From” on or before “To”.
reports.pick: Choose the establishment and the range, then press “Generate”.
reports.emptyDetail: There are no shifts at the establishment on those dates.

attendance.notPayroll: Administrative attendance data. This is not payroll or a pay calculation. Hours pending review are shown separately and are not added to validated hours.
attendance.csvNotice: ETNARA · Attendance report: administrative data, not payroll. Validated and pending shown separately.

assignments.shiftLine: Staff {{staff}} · residents cared for {{residents}} · substitutions {{substitutions}} · alerts {{alerts}}

occupancy.notice: Beds registered by the home. They are not the capacity authorized by the Department of the Family.

errors.fallback: The report could not be generated. Please try again.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_REPORT_RANGE_INVALID: The range must be 1 to 31 days.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the administration can view reports.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED: This report is not active for your organization.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the dates and try again.

activities.title: Activity for {{name}}
activities.body: It is recorded with the date, the time and your name. Non-clinical activities only.
activities.queued: Offline: the activity will be sent when the signal returns.
activities.nonClinicalHint: Do not write diagnoses, medications or health information.

errors.fallback: Could not record. Please try again.
errors.notEnabled: This activity type is not enabled at your home.
errors.notAssigned: This resident is no longer assigned to you.

family.eyebrow: Your family member at the home
family.todayEmpty: No activities have been recorded today yet.
family.historyDetail: Activities recorded by the home's team, with who recorded them, the date and the time.
family.historyEmpty: No activities have been recorded yet.
family.author: Recorded by: {{name}} · {{role}}
family.privacyNote: You only see your family member's information. Staff schedules, shifts and personal details are not shared.
family.noRecipientDetail: Once the home authorizes you, you will see your family member's information here.
family.messagesDetail: Write to the home's administration about your family member.
family.messagesNote: Only you and the home's administration see this conversation.
family.messagesError: The conversation could not be opened. Please try again.
family.sendError: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
